description: One data row of central/scenario_units.csv, read as an object of column name to cell text; an empty cell is null. The header row must be exactly the columns of x-columns, in that order. Generated from meterline_gold/write.py and meterline_gold/dataset_docs.py by meterline_gold.contract; do not edit by hand. Meaning of each column: docs/reference/gold-datasets.md and the gold spec, sections 6 to 8.

envelope.description: The unit's spending envelope in the scenario.

excess.description: How far the position at the end of the month is over the cap or envelope; 0.00 if not over.

position.description: Month-to-date cost_ref of the unit at the end of the month.

scenario_id.description: Id of the shadow scenario from the policy.

schema_version.description: GOLD_SCHEMA_VERSION of the build that wrote the file; the same on every row.

stopped_on.description: First day the position passed the cap or envelope; empty if it never did.

top_up_total.description: top_ups times the scenario's top-up amount.

top_ups.description: Number of top-up amounts needed to cover the excess.

unit_id.description: Organisation unit id from the organisation files.

title: gold-dataset-scenario_units
x-cost-column-rule: `position` is a month-to-date cost, `excess` a shadow figure; neither is added to spend.
x-grain: One row per scenario, month and unit with an envelope.
